Spinal Memory, the fourth issue of te magazine, grew out of a reflection on the imagining of non-human animals. As an extension of this issue’s theme, te editions is launching its first online lecture series, inviting nine speakers (including several contributors to this issue) to give eight online lectures.

Each speaker approaches this theme in a completely different way: years of companionship and careful field observation, or history, design, writing, moving image, archives, and data.
